textboxes.text: Oh, hey Buster. Sorry, I can't talk right now. I'm prepping for my job interview.
I'm REALLY anxious for it, but more than normal. I don't know why I'm so anxious!
Steve, buddy, relax! I got just the thing for 'ya. Try pulling out your phone, and start scrolling!
Wow, thanks Buster! My phone DOES make me feel better.
I think the reason I was so anxious is because I have a live bomb in my briefcase.
Haha, probably shouldn't bring that into work. I'll take that off 'ya hands.
<char_speak vapekid>Have you seen my mom?
Oh, no. I haven't.
<char_speak vapekid>Yeah, me neither. Wanna hang out?
Oh!<pause 20> No, not really.
(Inhale.)
What the- are you smoking!?
(Exhale.)
<char_speak vapekid>Nah. It's Trix flavored.
Can I bum a hit?
But... you're just a kid!
<char_speak vapekid>I'm 32. My mom is dead. Back off.
Let's get outta here.
[ MICROGAME ]
Hey, nice platforming you guys.
Used to do a bit of that in my day.
<char_speak want_gf>Man. I need a girlfriend.
<char_speak want_gf>Do either of you wanna be my girlfriend?
Um... Ahhh the Wizard is taking over the world ahhh let's go.
<char_speak pigeon_person>Heyyyy, Buster!
Ayyy! Pigeon Person! My man! How's it hangin'?
<char_speak pigeon_person>Just pigeon things, haha. Waiting for someone to drop a piece of bread or something.
<char_speak pigeon_person>Cuz' I'm a pigeon raaaagghh, hahaha.
<char_speak pigeon_person>Nah, I'm just playin'. Got a loaf this mornin' at Tallmart. I'm just waiting for my Uber.
Classic, man. That's classic.
Linda!!
<char_speak linda>Bridget! Girl, hey!! <break>You here to schedule an appointment?
Oh, not today! I still like the curls.<break>How are you?
Good, good! Things are good. Rod's on house arrest for making a waitress uncomfortable.
Alright, bye Linda.
Hahahaha! Boys will be boys......
Oh my gosh. Are you gonna finally go through with the divorce?
<char_speak old_man>Oh. You're the guy from the billboards. The little orange man with the company.
Hey, hey! Yeah!! If you got any demolition needs, we're your guys.
<char_speak old_man>See, right there. Perfect example of what's wrong with the world.
<char_speak old_man>Hiring someone else to clean their kitchen. Lazy! Get your hands dirty, GRAB A SPONGE!
What? We're a wrecking crew.<break>"<nopause>BOOM! Buster<yespause>", it's in the name.
<char_speak old_man>Wha? Huh? Oh, I see. I thought it said,<break>"Broom Duster". I thought you were a maid.
<char_speak old_man>And your uniform makes ya look like Mickey Mouse! Which reminds me, back in my day...
Hahaha, well, we better get going, haha.
<char_speak mother>Mm.. And.... I... (yawn)... mm...
Miss? Are you alright?
(Pssst. Hey. Down here.)
Huh?
<char_speak mother>Yo. I gained consciousness about an hour ago.
<char_speak mother>Don't tell her, though. What I got goin' on here is kind of a sweet gig.
<char_speak mother>Mm... Uh, oh! Oh, I'm sorry. I must have drifted off. Little guy kept me up all night, haha. Kids!
<char_speak mother>Was there something you needed?
(No one will believe you.)
Uh... No. No, nothing. Sorry, ma'am.
<char_speak mother>Oh, my baby! You are just the cutest. I could gobble you up!
<char_speak mother><nopause>Gagagagaga goo goo gagagaaga!!!! Pbbglflfffppptttttt.
THE END IS NEAR! THE END IS NEAR!
Lavender skies, don't fall for the lies!<break>Whispers of doom, an apocalypse brews!
My guy... chill.
<char_speak end_is_near>Okay, sorry.
<char_speak end_is_near>Sorry again about all that.
<char_speak end_is_near>Not sure why I did that. I'm actually pretty normal, so this was out of character for me.
<char_speak officer>Yep, that settles it. We've got a serial pencil on our hands here.
<char_speak officer>Drawing little people on the floor across the city. Sickening.
Looks pretty good, actually. I can't even draw a stick figure.
Can I have five bbbuckks.
WOAH! Bridget, look! A street performer! What can you do?
Umm... I can guess your favorite thing in the whole world.
Wow, my FAVORITE THING?<break>Hmmm... Let me think...
Okay, what's my favorite thing?
Something special, that's what.<break>You know why it's special?
Because it's important to you.
...Incredible.
Ok can I have five bbbuckks?
Take six, even.<break>You brilliant, brilliant soul.
What the-<pause 20><break>No,<pause 10> absolutely not.
What's in it for me?
Buster, let's go.
Ahh. The good ol' Mayor Abe statue.
A symbol of true Boomtown patriotism, that's for sure. Red, white, blue and all.
And purple!
<auto 5>Well, that's not a color on the flag
<textspd 0.8><auto 5>Red yellow green blue purple orange pink white brown black 123456789
<shake 1>EMPTY YOUR POCKETS.
OH, NO!
DON'T MUG US, PLEASE!
Wait. Buster? Bridget?
Hey you guys! Sorry about that, hope I didn't scare 'ya.
Heyyy, Jimmy! Knew it was you, buddy.
Hi Jimmy!
Hey, you two see the sky?
Blegh, don't remind me.
The Wizard's up to somethin' again.
Oh man, Zig's a riot. Holler at him for me, and let him know Sharon loved the baby shower gift.
Aw, Zig and his iconic thoughtfulness.
Seriously though, good luck you two. The Wizard's no joke, so stay safe out there!
Alright, gotta get back to work. Might steal a single mom's purse or something. See 'ya!
We're on our way to Zig's to see if he knows what's up with the sky.
Ahhh, the most boring part of the job... <break>The waiting game.
It's gonna be fine. Everything is... really fine!
Nah but for reals, the mayor will be missed. He was a real one.
Sigh, what happened to him was just cruel...
I can't believe his wheel fell off during the tragic dirt bike incident...
I would. The Wizard sucks, my feet are killing me.
And televised? Ugh. I wouldn't wish such an awful death on my worst enemy...
So sad that there was that tragic dirt bike incident and he died from that.
<char_speak linda>To be honest, I'm a little nervous.
<char_speak linda>Roads are blocked off, the sky's all funky, and there's little creatures running around everywhere.
Don't worry Linda, we're on it. Whatever the Wizard's up to ain't no sweat.
<char_speak linda>Rod picked up the girls from school, I don't want them out while everything is so crazy.
Your family's in good hands.
<char_speak linda>You two are the best. Do me a favor and stay safe out there, alright?
<char_speak linda>I can't lose my two favorite clients!
<char_speak business>Oh man... I'm definitely getting fired today. How am I gonna explain this?
<char_speak business>Sorry for being late! Hundreds of colorful little characters were blocking the road?
<char_speak business>I'm boned.
Stay safe out there.
<char_speak linda>Stay safe out there, you two.
<char_speak fortune>You, sir! You right there!
Me?
<char_speak fortune>I am the great Baba Bhavani, a fortune teller from another plane of existence.
Woah, cool! What do you do?
Um. I'm a fortune teller.
...<pause 30><break>I can read your mind.
A mind reader!? COOL!
Hmmm. What am I thinkin' about...
Okay, what am I thinkin' about?
<noskip><textspd 0.15><wave>Y o u  a r e  t h i n k i n g  o f<nopause> . . .
<char_speak fortune>Something awesome.
Bizarre...
<char_speak fortune>That'll be 5 bucks.
You take Venmo?
<char_speak fortune>Hey, follow me on Facebook.
<noskip><char_speak stranger0>Cursed with a clean slate...<break>   Could someone make the same mistake?
<noskip><char_speak stranger0>Hm. <pause 28>Nobody is fair enough to pose the question.
Oh, hey Buster! Doing alright. Yourself?
Hey fellas! How's it hangin'?
Good, good!
<char_speak vapekid>What? Back to rub my dead mom in my face? Stop talking to me.
<char_speak old_man>It's pretty hot today. But it's not the heat that gets 'ya, it's the humidity. <pause 20>I miss my grandkids.
Hope my driver doesn't throw bread at me again.
Hey, isn't that your cousin's van?
Oh, yeah! It is!!
He must be with a client right now. Probably shouldn't bother him.
Hehe, yeah. Dat guy's the coolest.
I bet he's curb stompin' some nasty critters in there. Wipin' out the joint.
Wow. That must be intense.
Man, how the hell am I gonna play Angry Birds now?
I tried earlier, nothin'.
That thing in the sky is messing with the connection.
<char_speak phone_guy>Work, dammit! Why won't you turn on?
<char_speak phone_guy>My freakin' phone won't turn on, it's all glitchy after that sky light thing.
Hey, Oscar. What's the problem?
Oh, mine seems to be working. Maybe you just need to charge it?
Nah, Zig talked about this. Electronics can act a little funky around magic.
You might've had yours on when that<break>sky thing opened.
<char_speak phone_guy>I hope so, because this totally blows.<break>Good luck Buster, you too Bridget.
But don't sweat it, buddy. We're gonna take care of this, just hang tight.
<char_speak phone_guy>Good luck, you guys.
I knew this ad would be a good investment.
When you're right, you're right. We're almost halfway done paying it off!
We already got a call this morning, and it's only been up for a month!
Haha, don't mind me. I guess I was just looking to be seen. Nothing more, really.
